mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the service hatch was most worthwhile: it finished the whale’s shape while keeping the controller and counterweight accessible.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the stop-button guide was the least informative passage on its own; its purpose became clearer when the pushrod was added.
